info.facebook: The majority of the campus' communication takes place via Facebook groups. New students can join the group 'Admis {year}' to make sure they don't miss any information:
info.integrationInformationDescription: Student life at Centrale Lyon is very rich and varied. Below, you will find some practical information to help you integrate into student life at Centrale Lyon.
info.myECL: The MyECL application is essential to student life at Centrale, it is mandatory to pay during numerous events and it will allow you to access plenty of services (the events calendar, the schedule of the film club, room reservations, and so forth).

introCarouselItem.contact: If you have any problems or questions, please do not hesitate to contact the Students council:
introCarouselItem.description: This website allows you to join associations (student clubs), to take your ticket for the integration weekend (WEI) or for other events scheduled for the Centralian integration. At the end of the process, you will be brought to pay online by credit card. This will save you precious time during the face-to-face mandatory validation.
introCarouselItem.selectCurriculum: To start, please select your curriculum:
introCarouselItem.solidarity: Some products contain a scholarship or solidarity price. The conditions for access to scholarship prices will be indicated each time. If you are not a scholarship holder but your situation does not allow you to pay without putting yourself in a critical situation, you can select the solidarity rate and you will be contacted to study your situation and propose a reduction accordingly.
introCarouselItem.welcome: Welcome to Centrale Lyon's associative Chaîne De Rentrée.

paymentButton.description: You will be redirected to HelloAsso to proceed to payment. HelloAsso is a French company offering payment solutions for associations. It is financed exclusively by donations. By default, HelloAsso will propose you to make a donation (called 'contribution volontaire' or 'voluntary contribution'), you can refuse to do so without compromising the payment. If you choose to make a donation, only HelloAsso will benefit it.
